about_the_game:
Bru & Boegie explode onto your personal workstation in the follow-up to Episode 1, for their biggest adventure yet! Another colourful, fully-animated and fully-voiced point and click game, full of irreverent humour and offbeat comedy satire, where simple things become unnecessarily complicated and convoluted puzzles.

You are BRU. All you want is some sugar for your coffee… but all of Earth's sugar is mysteriously disappearing. Can you point & click Bru through Kifftown to get to the bottom of the weird unfolding conspiracy? Fortune favours the bald, and now’s your time to shine (your head).

Features:

  • Keeping in Simple: Incredibly intuitive one-button-gameplay.

  • Rarefied Humor: Bru's particular brand of irreverent and satire on full display.

  • More Weird Characters: There's even more weird Kifftown inhabitants this time around with whom to interact.

  • Longer Playtime: With roughly double the length of the first game, this one's sure to keep you pointing and clicking for longer while you hold the fate of Bru's world in your hands.

  • New Mini-Games: More ways to idle away your precious, precious time.

  • Another Collect-o-thon: Is this a Hidden Object Game? Maybe?

  • Fringe Conspiracies: Discover conpiracy theories you probably never even knew about

  • Full-Voiced Human Cast: Talkie version.

All this and more await you in the Bru & Boegie: Episode 2 - Get da SUGAR!

Keep your eyes peeled for the announcement of Episode 3.
